title: Unsafe deserialization via Assembly.Load (csharp) — review required
description: The csharp call Assembly.Load rebuilds objects from a byte stream without a type allowlist, so the payload itself chooses which classes are constructed. Prefer a data-only format; when a native serializer is required, pass an explicit allowlist (Assembly.Load_safe). This lexical rule flags the call and does not resolve where the bytes come from.
remediation: Replace Assembly.Load with a data-only parser, or constrain the accepted types (Assembly.Load_safe).
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the Assembly.Load call; origin of the bytes and the reachable classes are out of scope.
